shadow.$description: Hairline borders do most of the surface separation work in Lumen. Shadows are reserved for floating UI (popover, dropdown, modal, toast). Shadow color references color.alpha.shadow.* (anchored at a fixed neutral #0E1219) so the cast stays stable across brand recolours. accent-glow references color.alpha.accent.24 — when the brand accent retunes (lime → spring green in v0.11), the glow inherits automatically. v0.11.13 — every inline `rgba(14,18,25,X)` and `rgba(74,222,128,0.24)` was migrated to the corresponding alpha.* primitive ref so the master→child inheritance chain holds.

accent-glow.$description: Warp's signature green-glow under primary CTAs. v0.11.13 — color now references {color.alpha.accent.24} (spring green #00FA8A at 0.24) so it inherits the v0.11 brand recolor automatically. Pre-v0.11.13 the colour was inlined as v0.4 lime rgba(74,222,128,0.24), creating a master-child drift that the runtime CSS already corrected but the source token did not.
